core_obligations: (1): quasi-compactness of the source together with quasi-separatedness of the target gives quasi-compactness of the morphism (proof line 2081)
(2): the first assertion together with the composition statement for quasi-separatedness, using quasi-separatedness of the source (proof lines 2082-2084)

(3): for quasi-compact quasi-separated stacks over a common base the projection of the fibre product is quasi-compact and quasi-separated by base change permanence and (2), and then the fibre product itself inherits both properties over the base (proof lines 2086-2097)
proof_roadmap: (2) 由 (1) 与「准分离的复合保持」。
(3) X ×_Y Z → Z 作为 X → Y 的基变换，由 (2) 与准紧/分离性质的基变换保持得准紧且准分离；再由与结构态射的比对，X ×_Y Z 本身准紧且准分离。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives three permanence statements: a morphism with quasi-compact source and quasi-separated target is quasi-compact; with quasi-separated source it is also quasi-separated; and a fibre product of quasi-compact quasi-separated stacks over a common base is quasi-compact and quasi-separated (author lemma at source lines 2067-2078, label lemma-quasi-compact-quasi-separated-permanence). The proof (source lines 2080-2098) derives the first two from the quasi-compactness permanence and the composition statement, and the third by applying the first two to the projection of the fibre product and comparing with the structure morphism over the base (proof lines 2080-2097). The reduction of the fibre product case to the projection is the substance. H3.
